Container.Name: my-echo-server
Container.Overview: Optional self-hosted companion server for My Echo (macOS, Apple TV, iOS). Indexes your Unraid music shares locally into compressed delta shards for Mac, powers MyEchoTV completely independently of macOS with 1-hop lossless streaming, includes a built-in dark-neon Web Player, and hosts always-on Party Mode with DJ Voice Intros.

Config.Name: API & Admin WebUI Port
Config.Description: Main API, compressed index delta shards, lossless streaming, and /admin WebUI.

Config.Name: Party Mode HTTP Port
Config.Description: Zero-install Party Mode Guest Web Jukebox (QR code URL).

Config.Name: Party Mode HTTPS Port
Config.Description: Companion HTTPS listener for mobile Safari/Chrome DJ Voice Intro microphone recording.

Config.Name: AppData Config
Config.Description: Stores SQLite database, pre-built compressed index shards, artwork thumbnail cache, TLS cert, and config.json.

Config.Name: Music Library
Config.Description: Primary Unraid music share (rw allows mirroring compressed index & auto-discovery beacon into .myecho/; ro also supported).

Config.Name: Server Display Name
Config.Description: Name displayed in My Echo on Mac, Apple TV, and Party Mode.

Config.Name: Advertise Host (Unraid LAN/Tailscale IP)
Config.Description: Unraid IP used for Party Mode QR code URLs when running in bridge mode.

Config.Name: 6-Digit Pairing PIN
Config.Description: Optional fixed 6-digit PIN for Mac & Apple TV pairing (auto-generated on first boot if blank).

Config.Name: Scan Interval
Config.Description: Incremental scan interval (e.g. 30m, 2h, 24h, or manual for webhook-only disk spin-down friendliness).

Config.Name: Legacy Mac SMB Prefix (Optional)
Config.Description: Optional macOS SMB mount prefix so server Track IDs match existing Mac playlists and ratings 1:1.
